description.value: The Duncan Garage Cafe & Bakery is an organic vegetarian cafe and bakery housed in a charming historic building in the heart of downtown Duncan. The menu leans heavily on fresh, locally sourced and seasonal ingredients, with extensive vegan and gluten-free options across breakfast, lunch, and a dedicated cakes program. Cyclists will find a full cafe bar, grab-and-go items, and frozen meals available throughout the day.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at duncangaragecafe.ca is active and detailed, confirming this is a legitimate restaurant/cafe at 330 Duncan Street, Duncan. The site explicitly identifies the business as 'your organic vegetarian oasis' with vegan and no-gluten options throughout the menu and cakes pages. Takeout and grab-and-go are confirmed via 'grab and go and frozen meals available during all opening hours' and the online ordering feature; no bike parking, washroom, water refill, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists the business as 'Duncan Garage' but the website consistently uses 'The Duncan Garage Cafe & Bakery'. OSM name retained per instructions, but the listing may benefit from an OSM name update.
OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed values for phone and address are null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established cafe in downtown Duncan with vegetarian/vegan/GF menu, grab-and-go options, and a historic building setting — a strong stop for Cowichan Valley touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website describes the cafe as 'your organic vegetarian oasis' and states 'we offer many vegan and no-gluten ingredient options'; cakes page confirms 'non-gluten, dairy free or vegan options' throughout

wow_evidence: organic vegetarian oasis... grab and go and frozen meals available during all opening hours

price.label: Casual
price.signal: Main entrees $15-16.50 CAD; casual sit-down cafe
